The description states that the Consistency-Uni method begins at AL=2, but the first data point for this series is clearly located at approximately AL=2.5.
The description incorrectly states that the final data point for the Consistency-Uni line is at AL=9. In the plot, this point is located at approximately AL=8.5.
The description states that the Consistency-Bi method starts at AL=2, but the first data point for this series is located at approximately AL=1.5.
The description incorrectly states that the final data point for the Consistency-Bi line is at AL=9. In the plot, this point is located at approximately AL=8.5.
